signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the platform product strategy and multi-year roadmap and balance investments across customer facing features and technical advancement.
Build and grow a high-performing technical product organization with clear success profiles, career growth, and a clear, prioritized backlog for every sprint team
Drive large, multi-quarter initiatives end to end across several engineering teams, resolving blockers early and championing urgency without compromising standards
Partner with Engineering VPs, Architecture, and Portfolio Product Management leaders as one leadership team, leading healthy debate that produces decisive trade-offs and faster…
Make platform health and delivery performance visible through business-quantified metrics, executive-ready roadmaps, and compelling business cases
Define portfolio-level product vision and strategy that shapes the direction of the business.
Drive innovation across multiple product areas through deep discovery and data-driven insight.
Partner with and influence executive leadership on company-wide strategic priorities.
Shape competitive, market, and commercial strategy, including enterprise pricing and packaging.
Align engineering, go-to-market, and external partners around a unified roadmap.
